opportunities.name: Movie night invite with IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes ratings
opportunities.description: Look up movie {title} on IMDb and Rotten Tomatoes for its director, runtime, IMDb rating and Tomatometer score, then draft an email inviting {recipient} to movie night on {day}.
steps: Open IMDb and dismiss the cookie banner if shown
Search IMDb for {title} and press Enter
Open the matching title result
Note the director, runtime and IMDb rating
Open Rotten Tomatoes and reject cookies if prompted
Search Rotten Tomatoes for {title} and press Enter
Open the matching movie result and note the Tomatometer score
In mail, start a new message to {recipient_email}
Set the subject to 'Movie night {day}: {title}'
Write the body: 'Hi {name}, {day} we watch {title} ({director}, {runtime}): IMDb {imdb_rating}, Tomatometer {tomatometer}.'
Save or send the draft (the user discarded it in the recording)

instances.values: title=The Grand Budapest Hotel; IMDb and RT lookups only, interleaved with npm 'express' lookup; no email drafted before the recording ended

opportunities.name: npm package health summary note
opportunities.description: Collect {package}'s latest version, weekly downloads, license, GitHub stars, open issues and last release date from npm and GitHub, and save them as a one-line note.
steps: On npmjs.com, search packages for {package} and press Enter
Open the exact-match package result
Note the version, weekly downloads and license
Click the GitHub repository link
Note the star count and open issue count
Open Releases and note the date of the latest release
In notes, add a new note: '{package}: v{version}, {weekly_downloads}/week, {license}, {stars} stars, {open_issues} open issues, last release {date}'

instances.values: package=express; partial: opened the npm page only, interleaved with the movie lookup

opportunities.name: Recipe pick with origin note
opportunities.description: Find a top Allrecipes recipe for {dish}, record its rating, total time and first ingredients, look up the dish's origin on Wikipedia, and save a note for {servings} people.
steps: On Allrecipes, search 'Find a recipe or ingredient' for {dish} and press Enter
Open the highest-rated matching recipe
Note the recipe name, star rating, total time and first three ingredients
On Wikipedia, search for {dish} and press Enter
Note the dish's origin
In notes, add a new note: '{dish} for {servings}: {recipe_name} ({stars} stars, {time}), needs {ingredients}. Origin: {origin}'

instances.values: dish=pad thai, servings=2 (searched for 'lemon tart' first, then switched to pad thai)
